mentions.name: Desktop OpenTelemetry Ingest App
mentions.description: This simple desktop app ingests OpenTelemetry data to support other projects, so no separate backend service needs to be set up just for telemetry collection.
mentions.problem: Avoids the overhead of setting up a separate service just to ingest OpenTelemetry data.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently, a simple desktop app for ingesting opentelemetry to help with other projects. This way, I dont need to set up another service just for that.
